ranked.headline: Computational models infer cell dynamics and spatial organization from transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics and proteomics tools now pair explicit dynamical, perturbation, and spatial models with large-scale descriptive atlases.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and new algorithms for single-cell regulatory and expression inference
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics now rely on benchmarked methods for clustering, feature selection, and transcription factor inference.

ranked.headline: Few-label adaptation and stochastic training extend protein and genomic prediction
ranked.summary: Few-label fitness prediction and leakage-free variant-effect modeling appear alongside benchmarks of genomic language models on RNA tasks.

ranked.headline: Curated references and coverage-aware tools refine microbiome taxonomic profiling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add reproducible references and profilers for fungal, cross-domain, and phage-host analysis of microbial communities.

ranked.headline: Manifold embeddings and physics-informed models of neural and cognitive dynamics
ranked.summary: Manifold embedding of dynamic brain data and physics-informed forecasting of Alzheimer's decline both target latent structure in neuroimaging.

ranked.headline: Assumption-light variant and repeat inference from long and short sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers present read-based tools for variant calling, shared-haplotype queries and tandem repeat sizing designed for scale.

ranked.headline: Duplication history shapes noncoding regulatory elements and miRNA network position
ranked.summary: T2T-genome and chromatin analyses now link segmental duplication to human-specific regulatory rewiring, alongside whole-genome-duplication miRNA pairs.

ranked.headline: Open tools for managing, annotating, and visualizing derived omics and genomic datasets
ranked.summary: Standardised, open tools now package validation, integration, and visualization of annotation, pangenome, and omics results.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and foundation models integrate single-cell data across contexts
ranked.summary: PanFoMaBench, a pan-cancer benchmark of over 3.5M cells, makes transfer of single-cell representations across tumour contexts an explicit evaluation target.

ranked.headline: Language models are being extended from single-cell representation to omics inference
ranked.summary: Pretrained models now span single-cell, metabolomic, and multi-omics data, with emerging conversational agents and phenotype prediction.

ranked.headline: Algorithms infer cell identity, lineage, and marker genes from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell lineage tracing and transcriptomic datasets are driving algorithms that resolve cell states, lineages, and marker panels at scale.

ranked.headline: Representation design for protein interaction and structure prediction models
ranked.summary: Late 2025 benchmarks and new encodings test whether protein representations generalize across interaction, flexibility, and mutation prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided generative models now scaffold enzyme active sites de novo
ranked.summary: Riff-Diff and RFdiffusion2 scaffold catalytic arrays and functional-group geometry into de novo enzyme designs.

ranked.headline: Mutation-level fitness and within-host dynamics inferred from pathogen sequence data
ranked.summary: Wastewater sequencing time series and large viral load datasets now support mutation-level fitness and within-host inference at population scale.

ranked.headline: Association methods add shrinkage, functional annotation and multitrait structure
ranked.summary: Recent papers and preprints add calibrated shrinkage, annotation priors and gene-level evidence to GWAS and rare-variant association inference.

ranked.headline: Genetic circuits as tunable-threshold perceptrons and resource-coupled neural networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat decision thresholds and shared translational resources as explicit design variables in genetic and protein circuits.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-aware linkage and crossover tools refine genetic association inference
ranked.summary: Explicit haplotype and crossover structure in genotype data is now modeled directly in association and linkage inference tools.

ranked.headline: Tractable parameter inference for stochastic and deterministic biological models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend simulation and inference for stochastic reaction networks and PDE-based models, with emphasis on reliability and parameter estimation.

ranked.headline: LLMs encode proteins, genomes, and DNA as tokens for prediction and molecular design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend language-model tokenization from text to protein dynamics, whole genomes, plasmid DNA, and drug-response signatures.

ranked.headline: Graph and invariant deep learning link tumor omics to clinical and molecular endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs graph, contrastive, and foundation-model architectures with multi-omics and imaging data for tumor biomarker and outcome prediction.

ranked.headline: Genomic profiles guide cancer biomarker selection and treatment response prediction
ranked.summary: Late-2025 work applies graph, kernel, and pathway-informed networks to RNA-seq, GDSC, and mutation data for oncology prediction.

ranked.headline: Coupled models link cell-level processes to cardiac valve and atrial mechanics
ranked.summary: Mechanistically coupled simulations are beginning to connect ion channel, calcification, and fluid-structure processes to chamber and valve function.

ranked.headline: Graph-based formulations resolve haplotypes under read ambiguity and mixed samples
ranked.summary: Graph formulations of haplotype reconstruction now model read ambiguity, uncertainty, and mixed or low-coverage samples.

ranked.headline: Generative models produce annotated biomedical training data and impute missing values
ranked.summary: Generative and foundation-model approaches now supply annotated training data, cell segmentation, and keypoint imputation for biomedical imaging.

ranked.headline: T2T assemblies and a mobile element resource resolve fungal and insect genomes
ranked.summary: Gap-free assemblies and a Starship database now expose large mobile elements, Y-linked content, and structural variants in complete genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer protein localization and cell identity from proteomics data
ranked.summary: Spatial, single-cell and tumor proteomics datasets are being analyzed with semi-supervised, neural and image-linked models to resolve biological organization.

ranked.headline: Detection and size control reshape inferred kinetics in stochastic gene expression
ranked.summary: Analytic reductions now resolve how measurement imperfection and cell-size regulation alter apparent rates in stochastic gene expression models.

ranked.headline: Ground-truth validation and quality control for genomic variant and structure calls
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add duplex-sequencing truth sets and orthogonal validation for CNV, SV, and karyotype calls from short- and long-read data.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and collision-free hashing for scalable sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools report quantified space, accuracy and validation metrics for sequence classification and ancient metagenomic authentication.

ranked.headline: Dual-encoder and convolutional models predict TCR and MHC peptide binding
ranked.summary: Deep learning models now combine TCR, MHC, and peptide sequence representations to predict binding and T cell immunogenicity.

ranked.headline: Simulators and cross-engine checks are testing reproducibility of biology software
ranked.summary: Simulators with ground-truth benchmarks and curated executable model files now allow tool performance and cross-engine agreement to be checked directly.

ranked.headline: Metagenomics maps subglacial and Danish environmental microbiomes at scale
ranked.summary: Danish atlas scale and a FAIR Antarctic monitoring pipeline push environmental microbiome studies toward reproducible, large-scale data reuse.

ranked.headline: Backbone-conditioned nucleic acid sequence design and RNA energy parameter inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend structure-conditioned sequence design to single-stranded DNA and refine RNA energy parameters.

ranked.headline: Network models of brain dynamics are being tested against empirical neural recordings
ranked.summary: Whole-brain and network-level models are increasingly evaluated against human imaging data and formal stability criteria, not only analytic theory.

ranked.headline: Generative and Bayesian samplers tested against protein conformational populations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply diffusion sampling, cryo-EM Bayesian inference, and protein language models to conformational ensembles and heterogeneity.

ranked.headline: Curated databases anchor taxonomic and mobile-element classification in genomic data
ranked.summary: Curated sequence resources now set taxonomic benchmarks for jingmenviruses, plasmid-borne secretion systems, and C. diphtheriae strain typing.

ranked.headline: Rhythmic dynamics and higher-order information in neural and speech systems
ranked.summary: Preprints now connect speech articulation limit cycles, neural mass oscillator ordering, and higher-order information measures for mechanistic inference.

ranked.headline: ML-driven platforms advance small-molecule identification and drug target profiling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication report LLM agents for LC-MS/MS identification and large-scale ML target profiling tools for early discovery.

ranked.headline: Simplified microbial community models require explicit criteria for when they fail
ranked.summary: Explicit diagnostic criteria are needed because Lotka-Volterra errors arise at coupling thresholds predicted by timescale separation.
